finding.title: The `MarkdownInput` array is declared with a fixed size of 4000 characters. If the user inputs more than 3999 characters, it could lead to a buffer overflow.
There is no validation or sanitization of the input to `MarkdownInput`. This could lead to injection attacks if the input is used in a context where it is interpreted (e.g., rendering Markdown).

errors: snippet.cpp:3:10: error: ‘vector’ in namespace ‘std’ does not name a template type

scan_orig.message: Statically-sized arrays can be improperly restricted, leading to potential overflows or other issues (CWE-119!/CWE-120).
